title: bidens reptans var. coreopsidis
intro: Bidens reptans var. coreopsidis, commonly known as Coreopsis stemless, is a perennial herb native to North America. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Coreopsis stemless include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, which aid in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
